messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a weekday adjacent to a weekend, creating a stretch of three or more consecutive days off.)

| Date range | Holiday(s) | Notes |
|------------|------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday 1, so the holiday was observed on Monday 2. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Third Monday in February. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday (most provinces) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in most provinces; the weekend is extended. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day (federal & most provinces) | Celebrated on the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jun 23–24** | St. Patrick’s Day (Quebec) | Observed on Thursday 23 because the holiday fell on Friday 24. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Mon 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday 1, so the holiday was observed on Monday 3. |
| **Aug 5–7** | BC Day (British Columbia) | First Monday in August. |
| **Aug 19–21** | Heritage Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan) | Last Monday in August. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day (all provinces) | First Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 10–11** | Remembrance Day (observed Thu 10) | Remembrance Day fell on Friday 11, so it was observed on Thursday 10. |
| **Dec 23–28** | Christmas & Boxing Day (all provinces) | Christmas on Monday 25, Boxing Day on Tuesday 26; together they create a six‑day stretch from Saturday 23 to Wednesday 28. |

### Quick Tips for Your App

1. **Use a holiday library** – e.g., `python‑holidays` (`pip install holidays`) can generate the same list programmatically for any year and province.  
   ```python
   import holidays
   ca_holidays = holidays.Canada(years=2023, prov='ON')  # specify province
   ```
2. **API alternatives** – services such as [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/) or the [Calendarific API](https://calendarific.com/) offer JSON endpoints for Canadian holidays by year and region.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by each province or formatted for a specific programming language!
